lastCompletedStory.title: Coalesce post-merge narration + prune sub-status into one notifyOrchestrator line

nextStoryContext: US-003 refactored warnOnPruneFailure in merge-watch.ts into a pure builder returning a string suffix (no notifyOrchestrator call inside). processPollResult now makes EXACTLY ONE notifyOrchestrator call on the MERGED success path, folding the prune sub-status into the [cam] post-merge complete: ... line. The suffix format is ' (warn: prune local <ok|FAILED>, remote <ok|FAILED>)' when either leg failed; empty string when both pruned. Five new tests in test/release/merge-watch.test.ts cover AC1 (exactly one completion line), AC3 (prune sub-status present/absent), AC4 (no second call), AC5 (logEvent detail unchanged). The existing (US-001) test still passes because the merged completion line contains 'warn' + 'prune'. US-004 is next: unit tests for end-state prune classification and coalesced narration (post-merge.ts SpawnFn tests).
